svg.title: Part 2 whole-file moves on the example 2333133121414131402
svg.desc: Files are tried from the right end of the disk towards the left. Each one moves into the leftmost run of free blocks that can hold all of it. On the example only files 9, 7, 4 and 2 move.

g.text: Part 2 · move whole files, right to left
each row shows the disk after one successful move · outlined: where the file landed
file 9 (width 2) → first free span with room, at index 2
file 7 (width 3) → first free span with room, at index 8
file 4 (width 2) → first free span with room, at index 12
file 2 (width 1) → first free span with room, at index 4
files 8, 6, 5, 3, 1 and 0 find no free span on their left that is wide enough, so they stay
